note: Family-owned RV park on the north edge of Hastings, surrounded by cornfields; level gravel pull-through sites. Game room (arcade, pool table) and meeting room; near the Hastings Museum and Kool-Aid exhibit. Nightly, weekly and monthly stays. --Claude
summary: Operator site confirms the 2025 rates ($27 water/electric, $38 full hookup), 20/30/50 A with full hookups on most spaces, pull-throughs, laundry, WiFi and year-round operation; all written. Gate facts: posted rate under $50, working website + phone. BUT Google Maps rates it 3.2 from 92 reviews, which is a drop under AWH's under-4-stars-with-25+-reviews rule (no --AWH note). Pin OK.
